scenes.text: Imagine you are standing in the middle of the Sahara Desert where for two hundred and fifty miles, there is absolutely nothing but hot sand except for one solitary tree.
Known as the Tree of Ténéré, this was recognized as the most isolated tree on Earth, a living miracle that survived for decades by sending its roots over one hundred feet deep into the dry ground.
But in nineteen seventy-three, a heavily intoxicated truck driver managed to drive directly into it, snapping the historic trunk and killing the world's loneliest tree instantly.
How do you crash into the only object in a quarter-million square miles of empty sand, and have you ever had bad luck this incredibly unbelievable? Tell me in the comments below!

meta.title: The Only Tree for 250 Miles... and Someone Hit It #shorts
